records.name: Emerald Lakeshore
records.attraction_reason: The lakeshore circuit is the experience: a loop round Emerald Lake whose payoff is the whole shore, not one point.

records.name: Iceline Trail
records.attraction_reason: A high circuit past glaciers and moraine lakes: the walk itself is what people come for, with no single payoff place.

records.attraction_reason: A level walk between the two Kananaskis Lakes: the shoreline route is the experience.

records.name: Lake Louise Lakeshore
records.attraction_reason: The level shore walk along Lake Louise is the experience; the lake has its own place record and the walk ends at no named point.

records.name: Mary Schaffer Loop
records.attraction_reason: A short shore loop at Maligne Lake: the loop is the experience.

records.name: Parker Ridge
records.attraction_reason: The draw is the ridge-top view over the Saskatchewan Glacier, a named payoff. Create the viewpoint and move the draw; until then the route carries it.

records.name: Plain of Six Glaciers (to teahouse and Abbot Pass viewpoint)
records.attraction_reason: The payoff is the Plain of Six Glaciers teahouse and the viewpoint beyond it. Create the places and move the draw; until then the route carries it.

records.name: Ptarmigan Cirque
records.attraction_reason: The payoff is Ptarmigan Cirque itself, a named landform. Create the place and move the draw; until then the route carries it.

records.name: Sunshine Meadows to Citadel Pass
records.attraction_reason: A walk across the Sunshine Meadows on the Divide: the meadows walk is the experience; Citadel Pass is an optional end.

records.name: Wilcox Pass
records.attraction_reason: The draw is the view of the Athabasca Glacier from Wilcox Pass, a named payoff. Create the pass viewpoint and move the draw; until then the route carries it.

origin.reason: payoff of the trail

records.name: Fenland Loop
records.attraction_reason: A forest loop with no destination (contract T4): the route is its own payoff.

records.name: Miette Mine Trail
records.attraction_reason: A short loop round the old mine site: the loop is the experience.

records.name: Lake Annette Loop
records.attraction_reason: The step-free loop round Lake Annette is the experience.

records.name: Moose Lake Loop
records.attraction_reason: A forest loop to a small lake and back: the loop is the experience.

records.name: Moraine Lakeshore
records.attraction_reason: The shore walk under the Ten Peaks is the experience; Moraine Lake has its own place record.

records.name: Paint Pots Walk
records.attraction_reason: The payoff is the Paint Pots, which already has a place record (sights/paint-pots); the draw moves to it when the ledger allows a relevance edit.

records.name: Rockwall Lookout (Rockwall fen)
records.attraction_reason: The payoff is the fen lookout behind the visitor centre. Create the lookout and move the draw; until then the route carries it.
